# Producer compatibility corpus (non-normative)

These are small, reviewable excerpts/minimizations of producer-shaped SPDX JSON
output. They test tolerant, lossless sorting compatibility only. **They are not
normative SPDX conformance fixtures, do not define validity, and do not add
either producer as a dependency.**

| Fixture | Producer source and pin | Attribution and licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scancode-toolkit-spdx-2.3.json` | ScanCode Toolkit SPDX output conventions, [`v32.0.0`](https://github.com/aboutcode-org/scancode-toolkit/tree/v32.0.0), reviewed 2026-08-28 | AboutCode contributors; overall repository licence Apache-2.0 (reference datasets may differ) |
| `lib4sbom-spdx-2.3.json` | lib4sbom README generated JSON example, [`v0.5.2`](https://github.com/anthonyharrison/lib4sbom/tree/v0.5.2), reviewed 2026-08-28 | Anthony Harrison and contributors; Apache-2.0 |

The fixture data intentionally uses neutral example identifiers and is not a
claim that either producer output is valid SPDX. Original project attribution
and licensing are retained above.
